newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks creep higher, reassured by strong NY.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks creep higher, reassured by strong NY.

text.p: Tokyo stocks crept higher in early Wednesday morning trade, reassured by strength in New York overnight as well as the stability of the yen, brokers said.
As it was the first day of trade for June delivery, dealers were likely to be active, they said.
After 16 minutes of trade, the 225-share Nikkei average was up 59.40 points or 0.30 percent at 19,949.29. Its June futures added 80 to 19,940.
"Hopefully, turnover will increase as we have started a new trading month," a broker at a middle-sized brokerage said.
